title: The Shrinking Discipline
prompt:
**Scenario.** A 200-element random test fails. Your first shrink step should be:

**Which approach is the best fit? The program only needs to print the letter.**

**A)** Rerun with the same input twice to check determinism

**B)** Delete one element and re-test — keep every deletion that preserves the failure

**C)** Print the entire input and read it

**D)** Double n to see if it still fails

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Deletion is the cheapest, most localizing shrink move: every preserved deletion eliminates a suspect. Determinism checks and printing come after a few deletion rounds.
